The destination to export the database to is empty

To get started please select a folder where all your music is stored. You can add more directories in the settings. Alternatively, import an existing database if you\'ve used the app before and exported it
The following directories are used in the imported database file. Please give us permission to access these to be able to play music by selecting each music directory using the button below.
Watch a short ad to permanently allow you to save one more remix
Watch a short ad to permanently allow you to save %1$d more remixes
No Reward Ad available! Reward granted automatically!
Here you can control the playback, like pausing, skipping a few seconds ahead, or changing the repeat mode.
Pressing this button allows you to edit intervals that should be repeated. Press it to continue…
Here you can change your intervals
The slider allows you to select an interval which should be played. Everything outside the slider values will not be played.
The buttons give you fine control over the exact interval. You can also add more intervals using the settings button.
The \"Save\" button allows you to give your remix a name and save it. When playing the remix the intervals as well as any sound effects will be applied. We\'ll get into the sound effects next…
Pressing this button allows you to add sound effects like reverb or equalizer to your remix. Press it to continue…
Here you can enable which sound effects you\'d like to add to your remix. Enabling the Checkbox will expand a customization window for your sound effect.
Here you can also change the speed and pitch of your remix, creating either slowed or sped up (nightcore) audio.
You\'ve completed the tutorial! You can restart it anytime from the settings screen (bottom right).
